scheme.artefacts: aweb.logs-receipt/1 and aweb.logs-checkpoint/1: the prefix and a newline, then the canonical object, signed by the did_key it names; a verifier accepts only keys the logs manifest declares for the logs-receipt or logs-checkpoint purpose
scheme.chain_cases: each case's events are stored rows in storage order; receipt_keys and checkpoint_keys are the keys the verifier knows; report is what verify must return
scheme.commitment: SHA-256 of 'aweb.logs-commit/1\n', the 32-byte salt, the envelope signing bytes and the raw 64-byte signature
scheme.encoding: strict canonical JSON under the hook event rules; digests are 64 lowercase hex; times are UTC to the millisecond; signatures are 86 characters of standard base64, no padding; byte strings in this file are unpadded base64url
scheme.event_hash: SHA-256 of 'aweb.logs-chain/1\n' and the canonical link {chain_epoch, team_id, team_seq, prev_event_hash, received_at, hook, producer_origin, content_commitment}
scheme.genesis: SHA-256 of 'aweb.logs-genesis/1\n' and the canonical genesis; every epoch after the first carries previous_checkpoint_sha256
